notes: Per-lane capacities are typical urban values (saturation flow about 1,800 veh/h with roughly half of each signal cycle green on signalised roads); they are assumptions, not measured at these sites.

Lanes come from the OSM lanes / lanes:forward / lanes:backward tags of the matched edge (general-traffic lanes, bus-only lanes excluded) when tagged (lanes_source 'osm'); untagged edges, and Overture networks, get at least the minimum lanes per direction above (lanes_source 'assumed').
Flows are general traffic (all motor vehicles minus buses and coaches).
Controlled junctions per km, cycle length and green share are typical inner London values assumed uniformly per road type, not the actual signal plans.

provenance.counts: UK DfT road traffic counts (AADF, AADF by direction, raw manual counts), Open Government Licence v3.0; estimation_method per point
provenance.flows: observation-based: directional AADF x weekday hourly share 07-19
provenance.state: speed, density and LOS are BPR / HCM control-delay estimates from assumed capacities and signal settings
